name: Hawaii Spring Supply Inc
old_description: Hawaii Spring Supply Inc is your ultimate destination for Truck and Trailer Parts. A locally owned business since 1956, we provide the Honolulu and Hilo communities with a vast inventory of truck and trailer parts. We also build driveshafts and fabricate parts.
about:
Hawaii Spring Supply Inc operates from two locations in Honolulu and Hilo, Hawaii. Founded in 1956, the company has remained a family-owned, locally operated business for over six decades. It identifies as an Asian-owned small business.

The company stocks a large inventory of truck and trailer parts, including suspension components, brakes, clutches, air valves, hitches, tires, wheels, and driveshafts. It also builds custom driveshafts and provides fabrication services for automotive parts. The shop is noted as the last certified spring shop in the state. Services include lighting services, same-day delivery, and pickup/delivery options.

The business serves the truck and trailer market in Hawaii, catering to commercial fleets, owner-operators, and repair shops in Honolulu and Hilo. It is associated with Power Heavy Duty and the National Association of Trailer Manufacturers (NATM). Customers include those needing trailer parts, truck parts, driveshafts, and custom fabrication.

The company emphasizes its legacy of excellence, knowledgeable staff, and manufacturer warranties as differentiators. Its certification as the last spring shop in the state underscores a commitment to quality and service.
